about_the_game:
HEROES OF THE ASHENWATCH

Enter the cursed lands of Ashen, a world overrun by plague and darkness. In this co-op action roguelike RPG, you and your allies will face relentless foes, and master unique hero abilities. Each run offers new challenges with procedurally generated levels, permadeath stakes, and ever-changing loot.

Gather your party in the Inn, upgrade your heroes, and plunge into the unknown. From swarming Ratkins to towering Plague Demons, every battle tests your reflexes, teamwork, and adaptability. Die, return stronger, and push further into the depths until you face The Pestilence itself.

KEY FEATURES

  • Unique Heroes
    Choose from a diverse roster of heroes including the Berserker, Rogue, Sorcerer, Templar, and more. Each character has distinct abilities, strengths, and weaknesses, ensuring that every playthrough offers a unique tactical experience. Heroes can be switched at the Inn, where you also manage gear, skills, and upgrades.

  • Deep Mastery System
    Heroes are defined by combining two masteries (such as Warrior, Holy, Assassin, Hunter, or Elemental), creating hybrid classes with unique playstyles. For example, the Templar blends the resilience of the Warrior with the divine powers of the Holy mastery. Experiment with different combinations to discover synergies and tailor your hero to your preferred combat style.

  • Procedural Levels with Endless Variety
    Every run presents new challenges with procedurally generated levels built from modular chambers. Enemies, events, and environmental hazards are randomized, forcing players to adapt their strategy on the fly. As you progress, levels become longer, enemies grow stronger, and the stakes rise higher.

  • Permadeath with Meta Progression
    Each run is a high-stakes battle against inevitable defeat. When your hero falls, the run ends. The more you play, the stronger and more versatile your roster becomes.

  • Challenging Enemies and Boss Encounters
    Face a wide range of foes, from swarming Ratkins to Plague Demons and zealous Cultists. Elite enemies introduce unpredictable combat mechanics, while multi-phase bosses test your skill, teamwork, and adaptability with battles that grow deadlier with each stage.

  • Seamless Cooperative Action
    Built from the ground up for co-op play, Heroes of the Ashenwatch lets you team up with friends online to explore, fight, and survive together. Coordinate strategies against hordes, combine hero abilities to overcome towering bosses, and experience greater depth and replayability with every run.
